label: Traditional Chinese
target_guidance: Use Traditional Chinese with consistent traditional characters and natural vocabulary. Preserve character voice and narrative rhythm.
punctuation_rule: Use Traditional Chinese publishing punctuation and 「」『』 quotation marks. Preserve symbol structure, repetition and pairing. Do not convert to simplified characters or Simplified Chinese punctuation conventions.
title_rule: Use conventional Traditional Chinese titles and section labels, such as 第3章, 序章 and 尾聲.
